parameters.content:
## AI Employee Feedback Analyzer

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API, Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2
2. Set 'Read Survey' node to your employee survey responses spreadsheet (needs Department, Rating, Feedback columns)
3. Set 'Monthly Report' node to a separate report spreadsheet
4. Update HR email address

Runs monthly: reads all survey responses, uses GPT-4o for theme extraction and sentiment analysis, generates report in Sheets, emails HR leadership.
